source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "development control" OR "planning regulation" OR "building regulations" OR "planning law"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"development control" OR "planning regulation" OR "building regulations" OR "planning law",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("building regulations" OR "development control" OR "planning law" OR "planning regulation")
